elements.title: Countries with a national NCD policy including physical activity, by region and country-income level, 2021
elements.content:
Bar chart; y-axis: Percentage of Member States; x-axis groups: WHO regions, World Bank income groups. Legend entries: NCD policy; NCD policy operational.
NCD policy | African Region | ~78
NCD policy operational | African Region | ~72

NCD policy | Low-income | ~76

NCD policy | Upper-middle income | ~87

NCD policy | High-income | ~92

Note: 1 An “operational NCD policy” is defined in the WHO NCD CCS survey as a policy, strategy or plan of action that is being used and implemented in the country and has resources and funding available to implement it.
